implement.description: Write new code, add a feature, or propose a patch from a description or spec

debug.description: Find the cause of a failure, error message, crash, or unexpected behaviour

review.description: Critique existing code or a diff for bugs, security problems, and correctness

architecture.description: Design a system, compare approaches, plan a change, or weigh tradeoffs

explore.description: Locate code, explain how something works, or summarize files

test.description: Design or write tests, or find gaps in test coverage

easy.description: A quick lookup or a small, well-specified change in one place

moderate.description: Reading several files, or a contained change or diagnosis

hard.description: Cross-cutting design, subtle bugs like races, security, or ambiguous goals
